# LifeKeel

> Your family's chart, kept current. LifeKeel is one home for what a family
> holds on file: savings, insurance cover, wills and papers. It shows what is
> there, where it looks light against a rough estimate, and the steps to take
> on a bad day. Not a budgeting app, not an AI financial advisor. Informational
> and educational only; not financial, investment, tax, or legal advice, and not
> a substitute for professional emergency services.

LifeKeel is free to start, with no credit card required. It never moves money
or buys products. Anything it sends for a person, such as emails to people they
name if they go quiet, stays off until they switch it on.

## Before, during and after

Everything below works from what the family adds. Items marked planned are not
available yet.

- Before: savings runway and emergency fund; life, income and health cover on
  file; policy renewals and duplicate policies for the same person; retirement
  and education pace; debt health; wills and papers on file; a "what if"
  simulator. Planned: overlap between partners' policies, one ordered list of
  next steps, a monthly letter.
- During: documents the family's adults can open (with optional passphrase
  sealing, no recovery); steps for seven kinds of bad day, which start when
  the person says what happened; optional emails to people they name if they
  go quiet. Planned: access for a named person outside the family.
- After: who to call, from the policy papers on file; a draft message to the
  person's own insurer, for them to edit and send. Planned: a how-to-claim
  guide per policy type, a claim-ready pack.

## Free

- Emergency Mode, with seven kinds of event.
- "What if" scenarios on the family's own figures.
- A readiness snapshot.
- Document upload and storage.
- Connect an email account so Keel can read financial mail.
- A roster for the whole family. Each adult has their own view and children
  get a simpler one.

## Keel Plus (paid, 7.99 pounds a month, cancel any time)

- Reads provider, policy number, amount and dates from an uploaded policy, for
  the person to confirm.
- A plain-language summary of financial email.

## Trust and data handling

- Connector passwords and access tokens are encrypted before they are stored.
- Financial data is never sold. Approved AI providers process it only for the
  request; the privacy notice lists who they are.
- No commissions and no ads. Revenue is subscriptions only.
- People can export their data and delete their account themselves from
  Settings.
